input.subject: URGENT – kitchen ceiling leak, 2 Alder Mews (ref HC-4-077)
input.body:
Dear Ms Reyes,

Thank you for telling us about the kitchen ceiling at 2 Alder Mews, Cobham Fold (ref HC-4-077). Water getting into a light fitting and a sagging ceiling is a safety issue, and we are treating it as an emergency. Please do the following now, if it is safe to do so:

1. Do not touch the wet light fitting or the switches for it. If you can reach the consumer unit (fuse box) safely with dry hands, switch off the lighting circuit for the kitchen. If water is near the fuse box, do not touch it.
2. Keep the cooker off, and stay out from under the sagging part of the ceiling. Keep children and pets out of the kitchen if you can.
3. Turn off the water at the main stopcock (often under the kitchen sink) and do not use the bathroom above until it has been checked.
4. Keep the bucket under the drip and move valuables and electrical items away.
5. If the ceiling looks like it is about to come down, or you see sparks or smell burning, leave the room and call 999.

A member of our team is arranging urgent attendance and will contact you as soon as possible. Please reply or call us to confirm you are safe, and tell us your availability for access.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

Dear Mr Quill,

We know you are away, but we need to let you know about an emergency at 2 Alder Mews, Cobham Fold (ref HC-4-077). The kitchen ceiling stain the tenant reported on 20 September is now dripping steadily, the ceiling is sagging, and the light fitting above the cooker is wet and has flickered. The bathroom is directly above, so the likely cause is a leak from the bathroom.

Because of the risk from water near electrics and the ceiling coming down, we are arranging urgent attendance to make the property safe and find the leak. This is emergency safety work, so it will not wait for your approval. We will ask for your approval before any further repairs beyond making the property safe. The cost is not known yet.

If you can, please reply or call to say who you would like to attend, and to tell us about any insurance arrangements for the property.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
